name: agent
title: Agent
description: Procedural 3D mascot for React Three Fiber. Seven roles with their own gear, twelve typed actions, held props and reduced motion.

files.content:
export const agentRoles = [
  "orchestrator",
  "architect",
  "researcher",
  "builder",
  "debugger",
  "inspector",
  "analyst",
] as const;

export type AgentRole = (typeof agentRoles)[number];

export const agentActions = [
  "idle",
  "wave",
  "walk",
  "type",
  "inspect",
  "point",
  "read",
  "carry",
  "direct",
  "celebrate",
  "measure",
  "check",
] as const;

export type AgentAction = (typeof agentActions)[number];

export const agentRoleLabels = {
  analyst: "Analyst agent",
  architect: "Architect agent",
  builder: "Builder agent",
  debugger: "Debugger agent",
  inspector: "Inspector agent",
  orchestrator: "Orchestrator agent",
  researcher: "Researcher agent",
} as const satisfies Record<AgentRole, string>;

export const agentSignatureActions = {
  analyst: "point",
  architect: "measure",
  builder: "type",
  debugger: "inspect",
  inspector: "check",
  orchestrator: "direct",
  researcher: "read",
} as const satisfies Record<AgentRole, AgentAction>;

props.description: A group of meshes. Render it inside a React Three Fiber Canvas with lights. It stands on y = 0 and is about 2.4 units tall with its headgear.

props.name: role
props.description: Which accessory kit the mascot wears. The rig, clips and materials are shared.

props.name: action
props.description: Clip to play. Changing it crossfades over 0.38 seconds.

props.name: actionRef
props.description: Drives the action from a ref that is read every frame, so switching never re-renders. Wins over action.

props.name: focused
props.description: Turns toward the camera, leans in and hops once. Drive it from hover or focus.

props.name: motion
props.description: reduced holds each clip's key pose with no blink, breathing or loops.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Blob contact shadow under the feet. No shadow maps are used.

props.name: position
props.description: Placement. Every React Three Fiber group prop except children is accepted, including rotation, scale and pointer handlers.
One kit per role in accessories/registry.ts. To add a role, extend agentRoles in types.ts, write one accessory module and register its kit. The Record type fails the build until the kit exists.

props.name: head
props.description: Hats and helmets. Anchored on top of the body.

props.name: face
props.description: Glasses and shades. Anchored on the eye line.

props.name: torso
props.description: Props held against the front, such as a laptop or a book.

props.name: body
props.description: Coats and vests that wrap the body.

props.name: rightArm
props.description: Held props. Use useHeldPose to re-aim them per action.

props.name: leftArm
props.description: Mirrored arm. Write it like the right arm with +x pointing outward.

variants.name: role
variants.description: Selects the accessory kit: headgear, coat, glasses and the props in each hand.

variants.name: action
variants.description: Selects the clip. Held props re-aim with it, so the builder stows the laptop while carrying and walking.

variants.name: motion
variants.description: full plays the clips. reduced holds the key pose.

examples.title: Agent in your own Canvas
examples.description: Any React Three Fiber canvas works. The agent stands on y = 0, so lower it to centre it under the camera.

examples.title: Switch actions without re-rendering
examples.description: Write to actionRef from event handlers. The rig reads it every frame and crossfades.

accessibility: The mascot is decorative. Wrap the Canvas in an element with role=img and a label, or mark it aria-hidden.
Put anything the agent communicates in text next to the canvas.
motion=reduced, or the prefers-reduced-motion query when motion is omitted, holds each action's key pose. No blink, breathing, bobbing or loops.
The agent adds no focusable elements and never captures focus. Pointer handlers pass through to the group.
Pass focused from hover and focus state so keyboard users get the same reaction as pointer users.

animation.properties: Arm, leg, body and eye transforms
animation.timing: One useFrame per agent. 0.38 second smoothstep crossfade between clips.

animation.properties: Body yaw, tilt, root height, squash
animation.timing: Damped turn at rate 7, one 0.42 second hop.
animation.reducedMotion: Leans in slightly. No turn or hop.

animation.timing: 0.13 seconds every 3.4 to 5.6 seconds, offset per agent.

docs: Requires React 19. Render <Agent role="builder" /> inside a React Three Fiber <Canvas> with lights, or add agent-stage for a ready scene.
